speakers.name: Ravi Thakkar, Malkesh Dutta, Himal Solanki, Kiran Borhade, Abhishek Reddy
speakers.biography_html:
A highly experienced cohort of Odoo Implementation Consultants and Team Leaders, this team brings deep domain expertise in manufacturing ERP—from inventory and routing to costing, helpdesk support, subcontracting, and analytic accounting. 

Ravi Thakkar brings extensive domain expertise in core MRP architecture, specializing in barcode-integrated data collection and scalable Bill of Materials (BOM) design. 

Malkesh Dutta brings deep background in demand forecasting, inventory optimization, Master Production Scheduling (MPS), and enterprise capacity planning strategies.

Himal Solanki is a specialist in total quality management (TQM), cross-app inventory synchronization, equipment maintenance protocols, and post-production repair workflows.

Kiran Borhade specializes in shop floor optimization, labor and work center efficiency tracking, external subcontracting logistics, and multi-tier product costing frameworks.

Abhishek Reddy focuses on advanced engineering management, with extensive experience driving Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Engineering Change Orders (ECO), and complex Engineer-To-Order (ETO) setups.

Together, they have executed numerous Odoo rollouts, delivering functional depth, hands-on training, and real-world manufacturing best practices geared toward driving operational excellence

speakers.name: Manushi Shah
speakers.biography_html:
Manushi Shah is an experienced Odoo Developer with a strong focus on building scalable and maintainable solutions within the Odoo framework. She has worked on complex development challenges and real-world projects, with a particular emphasis on clean code, architecture, and effective problem-solving.

Alongside development, Manushi is passionate about mentoring and coaching developers. She encourages developers to understand the why behind technical decisions rather than simply following established patterns. She actively contributes to technical discussions, hackathons, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing initiatives within the Odoo community.

What You'll Learn

Join this masterclass to explore the fundamentals of effective Odoo development: from understanding the framework and extending existing functionality to writing clean, maintainable, and scalable code.

We’ll look at practical development approaches, common mistakes, debugging techniques, and how to make better architectural decisions when building custom Odoo solutions.

Who Should Attend

  • Odoo developers looking to strengthen their development skills
  • Developers working on custom modules and complex implementations
  • Developers interested in Odoo architecture and best practices
  • Developers looking to improve their debugging and problem-solving approach

speakers.name: Soumya Mukherjee
speakers.biography_html:
Soumya is a developer in Odoo PS team, often found untangling “random slowness” that shows up at the worst possible time. He digs deep into logs, SQL, and ORM to hunt down performance issues that others write off as “just Odoo being Odoo.”

Before joining PS, he worked with the R&D BI team and has delivered major contributions for odoo's spreadsheet and dashboard modules, while currently contributing  custom modules and business flows for clients with big ideas and even bigger databases, always with a focus on stability and speed.

When things slow down, Soumya speeds up with logs, logic, and just enough caffeine.

He’s excited to take the stage and share the kind of lessons you only learn when everything breaks in production.

speakers.name: Vivek Sanghi
speakers.biography_html:
Vivek Sanghi is a technology leader, entrepreneur, engineer, and the Co-Founder & COO of HashStudioz Technologies-an Odoo Authorized Partner and global product engineering consultancy. With over 20 years of IT industry leadership, Vivek combines deep technical architecture, growth strategy, and customer-centric design to scale enterprise solutions across more than 20 countries.

Throughout his career, Vivek has helped organizations modernize customer-facing processes, automate complex workflows, and build unified digital ecosystems leveraging Odoo, Salesforce, Cloud, AI/ML, and Industrial IoT.

He operates on a core philosophy: technology shouldn’t just innovate for novelty’s sake—it must make businesses agile, connected, and measurable.

At Odoo Experience 2026 India, Vivek presents a business-first approach to HeyDoot + Odoo, demonstrating how enterprises can transform WhatsApp into a fully connected sales, support, and CRM engine synced directly with their Odoo ecosystem.

After two decades in tech, Vivek continues to learn, experiment, and build what’s next.

speakers.name: Amit Parik
speakers.biography_html:
My name is Amit Parik, and I am the Managing Partner at BrowseInfo, a specialised Odoo system integrator that I have been leading since 2013. Before starting BrowseInfo, I worked at Odoo (formerly OpenERP), where I built a strong foundation in the product and ecosystem.

At BrowseInfo, we focus not only on Odoo development but primarily on end‑to‑end business consulting and implementation. Our goal is to understand clients’ business processes in depth and then design Odoo‑based solutions that are practical, scalable, and aligned with their operations. We act as a true implementation partner—covering process analysis, solution design, configuration, customisation, integration, training, and ongoing support.

Since 2013, I have successfully executed 100+ Odoo implementations across India and globally, across industries such as manufacturing, trading, services, retail, NGOs, education, and more. BrowseInfo is also well known in the Odoo community for its large portfolio of ready‑to‑use Odoo apps and vertical solutions published on the Odoo Apps store, which help partners and customers speed up their projects and reduce custom development.

With strong functional and technical understanding of Odoo, I specialise in implementation‑driven consulting—keeping solutions as close as possible to Odoo standards while still addressing complex business needs.

speakers.name: Hiren Gohil
speakers.biography_html:
Hiren Gohil is an Odoo Developer and Custom Module Team Lead with experience in Odoo development and database upgrades.

He specializes in upgrading Odoo databases and customizations to newer Odoo versions. His work includes migrating and making custom modules compatible with newer versions, analyzing framework and API changes, and writing custom upgrade scripts to ensure smooth and reliable data migration.

As a Custom Module Team Lead, Hiren works on complex upgrade projects involving database migration, custom module compatibility, customization upgrades, and testing. He is passionate about solving technical upgrade challenges and sharing practical knowledge with the Odoo developer community.

speakers.name: Dipali H
speakers.function: PIM Evangelist and Product Lead, OdooPIM
speakers.biography_html:
Dipali Holagi is a PIM Evangelist and Product Lead for OdooPIM at Navabrind IT Solutions, where she plays a key role in shaping the product’s strategy, roadmap, and evolution.

Working at the convergence of business, technology, and product innovation, Dipali brings a deep understanding of the product data challenges faced by retailers, distributors, and e-commerce businesses. She works closely with customers and cross-functional teams to translate complex business requirements into scalable product capabilities, helping shape OdooPIM around real-world market needs.

As Product Lead, Dipali is actively involved in product planning, solution strategy, release management, and product governance, with a strong focus on ensuring that OdooPIM delivers measurable business value and a reliable customer experience.

A passionate advocate for Product Information Management and digital transformation, Dipali believes that high-quality, AI-ready product data is becoming a strategic growth asset for modern businesses. Through her work with OdooPIM, she is focused on helping organizations move beyond fragmented, manual product-data processes to more intelligent, governed, and scalable ways of managing product information.

speakers.name: Prerak Mehta
speakers.biography_html:
Prerak Mehta
Business Analyst & Sr. ERP Consultant | AI-Driven Business Solutions

Prerak Mehta is a Business Analyst and ERP Consultant who brings a rare combination of enterprise consulting depth, genuine entrepreneurial experience, and hands-on exposure to modern AI-driven workflows. With 5 years of dedicated experience as a business analyst and ERP consultant, he specializes in translating complex operational realities into clean, scalable ERP solutions.

What truly sets Prerak apart is the 7 to 8 years of real-world business experience he brings prior to his consulting career. He has manufactured spare parts for vehicles, including motors and accessories, giving him direct exposure to production floors, supply chains, and inventory operations. He has run a retail clothing business, which sharpened his instincts around sales, merchandising, and customer behavior. He has also worked inside a chemical manufacturing company, adding process-driven industry knowledge to his portfolio. This lived experience means Prerak does not just map requirements to modules; he thinks like the business owner sitting across the table, because he has been that business owner.

Alongside his ERP expertise, Prerak has built strong practical experience with AI and agentic workflows in the business context. He has explored the integration of AI agents into ERP processes to automate repetitive tasks such as data entry, invoice reconciliation, lead qualification, and reporting. He has hands-on exposure to LLM-powered assistants for enhancing decision support inside Odoo, and has contributed to designing agentic workflows that reduce manual bottlenecks in sales, procurement, and inventory cycles. His approach combines business logic with AI capability, ensuring that automation solves the real problem rather than just adding technology for its own sake.

Prerak is known for his excellent communication skills and strong business acumen, which allow him to bridge the gap between stakeholders, developers, and end users with clarity and confidence. He is comfortable running discovery sessions, translating business pain points into structured requirements, and guiding clients through implementation with a practical, outcome-first mindset.

At KoderXpert, Prerak is positioned as the go-to consultant for clients who want an advisor with genuine skin in the business game, backed by both traditional ERP mastery and forward-looking AI capability. For any organization looking to modernize operations through Odoo ERP and intelligent automation, Prerak offers the rare mix of empathy, expertise, and execution that turns technology into measurable business value.

speakers.name: Tiru Chembeti
speakers.biography_html:
Tiru Chembeti is a Finance and ERP transformation leader with 15+ years of experience spanning finance, auditing, ERP implementation, and digital transformation. He has over 11 years of experience working with ERP platforms, leading strategic ERP implementations and transformation initiatives across manufacturing, distribution, professional services, logistics, construction, and finance.

He currently serves as Vice President – ERP Product Development & Professional Services at Reachware, where he leads ERP product strategy, roadmap planning, development execution, and customer-focused solutions. His experience includes implementing and optimizing ERP platforms such as Odoo, ERPNext, and Oracle l NetSuite for organizations across multiple industries and geographies.

Tiru has designed and developed custom ERP products and solutions addressing complex business and compliance requirements, including VAT/GST/TDS automation, advanced budgeting, subcontracting management, property and equipment management, lease management, AR/AP netting, and IFRS reporting.

He holds professional certifications including CMA and CA, along with certifications in ERP, Professional Accounting, SuiteFoundation, Advanced Revenue Management, Multi-Book Accounting, and functional consulting certifications for Odoo and ERPNext.

With a strong combination of finance expertise, ERP knowledge, and hands-on implementation experience, Tiru brings practical, real-world insights into ERP transformation, implementation challenges, and how organizations can leverage ERP systems to build scalable and efficient business processes.

speakers.name: Saurav Kumar
speakers.biography_html:
Saurav Kumar is a Business and Digital Transformation Consultant with nearly 22 years of experience helping organizations simplify complex operations and turn technology into measurable business value.

As the Founder and CEO of GeoTechnoSoft, he has led transformation initiatives across mining, manufacturing, government, rural development and service enterprises. His work connects every layer of a business—from operations, inventory, procurement and logistics to finance, customer management and strategic decision-making.

His transformation philosophy is simple: technology alone does not transform an organization—people, processes and purpose do. ERP, data analytics, automation and AI become powerful only when they are aligned with real business challenges.

More recently, Saurav has been helping organizations move beyond conventional digitization by integrating AI into business operations, decision-making and customer experiences.

Through the CIS “Mine to Money” transformation, he demonstrates how a traditionally operated limestone mining enterprise was connected digitally—from extraction and processing to inventory, sales, invoicing and payment—creating greater visibility, accountability and control across the organization.

speakers.name: Sanjeev Aggarwal
speakers.biography_html:
Sanjeev Aggarwal is the Founder & CEO of Agbe India, an ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified digital transformation company and an Odoo Silver Partner. With over 25 years of experience in enterprise technology, he has led large-scale transformation initiatives across manufacturing, automotive, retail, BFSI, healthcare, and services.

Before founding Agbe India, Sanjeev held leadership roles at global technology organizations, where he built and led enterprise consulting and delivery teams. Today, he advises businesses on scaling operations through ERP, process excellence, automation, analytics, and organisational discipline.

He is also the author of a book, "ERP IS NOT SOFTWARE: 7 Operational Disciplines That Separate Scalable Businesses From Chaotic Ones", which challenges conventional thinking around ERP implementations and business transformation.

At Odoo Experience India 2026, Sanjeev would like to share practical insights from real-world implementations on why successful ERP journeys depend as much on leadership, operational discipline, and change management as they do on technology.

speakers.name: Georges Baekelmans
speakers.biography_html:
Being born a Belgian - Georges lives in Chennai India for the past 30 years and is married to an Indian Lady. He is an engineer in Electro-mechanics and started Insoft.com 28 years ago.

Insoft.com flourished for 27 years as a provider of outsourcing services to European and American companies. Insoft stopped that business model and decided to put all their eggs in the Odoo Partner Basket at the start of 2025. They only do Odoo and focus on the South India market.

An active freemason, Georges is also Chairman of the South India Chapter of The Indo-Belgium-Luxembourg Chamber of Commerce and Industry.

speakers.name: Nitin Chandure
speakers.biography_html:
Nitin Chandure
Executive Vice President, Greytrix Business Solutions

Nitin Chandure is the Executive Vice President at Greytrix Business Solutions, where he leads ERP, HRMS and CRM implementation strategy across a global client base spanning manufacturing, Distribution, food processing, retail, pharma, and services industries. With a career built around Sage X3, Sage CRM, Sage 300p, Sage Intacct, and Odoo implementations, Nitin has been instrumental in shaping Greytrix's implementation methodology — a framework refined over the company's 25-year journey and applied across hundreds of successful ERP transformations worldwide.
His expertise spans the full implementation lifecycle: requirements analysis, business process consulting, solution architecture, and post-go-live support, with particular depth in manufacturing and supply chain-driven businesses. Nitin has played a key leadership role in expanding Greytrix's presence across India, Africa and the Middle East, where the company recently achieved Sage Platinum Partner status, and he regularly represents Greytrix as a keynote speaker at partner and industry conferences.
Known for translating complex ERP challenges into practical, repeatable frameworks, Nitin brings a rare combination of technical depth and business consulting acumen — helping organizations not just implement ERP systems, but implement them in a way that actually delivers on their promise.

With the perfect balance of technical & functional expertise, I ensure to deliver systems with 99.9% Uptime. This precision drives uninterrupted productivity and elevates overall business posture.

𝐒𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐢𝐥𝐢𝐳𝐢𝐧𝐠 𝐔𝐧𝐬𝐭𝐚𝐛𝐥𝐞 𝐎𝐝𝐨𝐨 𝐄𝐑𝐏 𝐒𝐲𝐬𝐭𝐞𝐦𝐬: Sometimes excessive customizations or failure to follow Odoo best practices, can misalign your system, turning even basic tasks into challenges. Leveraging my expertise & debugging skills, I realign your ERP system, restoring stability and ensuring smooth, reliable operations. It’s like straightening a spine or re-aligning your chakras for better posture. This transformation optimises productivity and performance across the board.

speakers.name: Ajeet Kumar Yadav
speakers.biography_html:
Founder & Chief Executive Officer | Softprime Consulting Pvt Ltd

Ajeet Kumar Yadav is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Softprime Consulting Pvt Ltd, a global digital transformation and enterprise technology consulting company specializing in ERP implementation, business automation, artificial intelligence, and industry-specific software solutions.

With more than a decade of experience in enterprise technology, ERP consulting, Python development, and large-scale business process transformation, Ajeet has built a reputation as a trusted technology leader and one of the most experienced Odoo implementation specialists serving clients across India, East Africa, the Middle East, Europe, and North America.

Under his leadership, Softprime Consulting has successfully delivered 200+ ERP and digital transformation projects across diverse industries, including Energy & Petroleum, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Logistics, Hospitality, Education, Construction, and Professional Services. The company has become recognized for delivering scalable, enterprise-grade solutions that help organizations streamline operations, improve visibility, and accelerate growth.

Ajeet's expertise extends beyond traditional ERP implementations. He is a strong advocate of integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, IoT, Cloud Infrastructure, Business Intelligence, and Automation Technologies into modern enterprise ecosystems. His strategic vision has enabled organizations to transition from fragmented legacy systems to intelligent, data-driven platforms that support real-time decision-making and sustainable business growth.

One of his most notable achievements includes leading the digital transformation journey of Horn Petroleum Group, where he spearheaded the implementation of a centralized Odoo ERP ecosystem supporting more than 100 users across multiple business entities and operational locations. The project unified finance, procurement, inventory, fuel operations, logistics, and reporting into a single platform, delivering significant improvements in operational efficiency, transparency, compliance, and executive decision-making. The implementation also introduced advanced analytics and automation capabilities, establishing a benchmark for ERP excellence within the regional energy sector.

As a technology entrepreneur, Ajeet continuously drives innovation through investments in AI-powered business solutions, cloud-native architectures, DevOps automation, and industry-focused ERP products. His commitment to quality, innovation, and customer success has positioned Softprime Consulting as a trusted digital transformation partner for organizations seeking long-term technology leadership.

Beyond business, Ajeet is passionate about fostering open-source innovation, mentoring emerging technology professionals, and contributing to the global Odoo ecosystem. He regularly shares insights on ERP strategy, enterprise automation, AI adoption, and digital transformation, helping organizations navigate the evolving landscape of modern business technology.

Key Areas of Expertise
Enterprise Digital Transformation
Odoo ERP Strategy & Implementation
AI-Powered Business Automation
Python Development & Software Architecture
Cloud Infrastructure & DevOps
Business Intelligence & Analytics
Multi-Company ERP Deployments
Manufacturing & Supply Chain Solutions
Energy & Petroleum Industry Solutions
Healthcare Information Management Systems (HMIS)
IoT & Industrial System Integrations
Executive Technology Leadership

tracks.speaker_line: Kuldeep Joshi, Praveen C, Vishnu Ramesh, Hitesh Dodiya, Prashant Malvaniya, Implementation Consultants at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007

Who is this Masterclass for?

This masterclass  is tailored for experienced Odoo users and implementing partners who are ready to:

  • Customize apps and screens without coding. 
  • Allows users to add fields, modify views, and automate workflows easily.
  • Master advanced reporting techniques in Odoo.
  • Leverage Spreadsheets to craft impactful dashboards.
  • Gain insights into best practices for Business Intelligence and performance optimization.

Prerequisites:

  • A strong foundation in Odoo applications is required.
  • Prior experience with Odoo Studio or Spreadsheets is recommended, but not mandatory.
  • A passion for data analysis and problem-solving.

Note: This masterclass is not suitable for beginners or those unfamiliar with Odoo Studio & spreadsheets.

Why Attend?

  • Be Ahead of the Curve: Get hands-on with the latest features of Odoo 19 before they’re released to the wider community.
  • Practical, Real-World Learning: Apply your new skills to real-life scenarios, from CRM pipeline analysis to cash flow forecasting and beyond.
  • Expert Guidance: Learn directly from Odoo Studio & BI Experts and gain exclusive tips, tools, and best practices.
  • Connect and Grow: Network with Odoo’s vibrant community and exchange ideas with experts and peers.

What you’ll learn:

This intensive training is designed to make you a data wizard. We’ll cover:

  • Customize forms, views, and menus without coding.

  • Create new apps and database models visually.

  • Automate workflows using triggers and server actions.

  • The Role of Business Intelligence in Odoo: Unleash the potential of your Odoo data.
  • Odoo Database Structure: Understand the foundations of data organization.
  • Excel Tips & Tricks: Master impactful formulas and techniques.
  • Data Insertion & Manipulation: Learn to clean, transform, and prepare data.
  • Visualization Techniques: Create stunning graphs, KPIs, and dashboards.
  • Access Rights & Sharing: Securely manage your data.
  • Best Practices & Advanced Tips: Avoid common pitfalls and optimize performance.
  • Use Case Applications: Solve real-world challenges such as CRM analysis, budgeting, and commission calculations.
  • Print Report Customization 
  • Approval rules on different models

tracks.name: Master class - Advanced Point of Sale
tracks.speaker_line: Mohammed Asif | Jatin | Chirag | Priyanshi | Ritika
tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007


Prerequisites

Participants should have a good understanding of Retail and Restaurant operations. A basic familiarity with Odoo’s Point of Sale (POS) system will be beneficial to fully engage with the advanced topics covered in this Smartclass.

Why should you attend?

✅ Participate in hands-on training – Gain practical experience using Odoo POS for retail and restaurant businesses.

✅ Engage in expert-led discussions – Learn from industry professionals and get direct answers to your questions.

✅ Discover best practices – Streamline operations and optimize sales with the latest Odoo features.

✅ Integrate seamlessly – Explore how Odoo POS connects with payment providers, delivery apps, and other hardware like printer, KIOSK and other integration too 

✅ Network with professionals – Exchange insights and strategies with business owners and Odoo experts.

✅ Experience the latest innovations – Get early access to Odoo’s newest POS features before a wider rollout.


During this 2-day Smartclass, you will discover:


🍽 Restaurant Order & Table Management

Streamline order-taking and manage tables efficiently for restaurants. Ensure a smooth and organized dining experience for both customers and staff.


🍽 Self Order management and Online Booking and waiting list management

Learn how to unify restaurant operations with self-ordering, real-time table bookings, and smart waiting list handling.

Enhance customer experience, reduce wait times, and optimize table management using modern POS solutions.

🚀 Swiggy & Zomato Integration

Automatically sync online food delivery orders with your Odoo POS system, reducing manual entry and ensuring more accurate, efficient order processing. This will save you time, reduce errors, and improve operational efficiency across your restaurant.


🛒 Boost Retail Sales

Learn how to manage product catalogs, promotions, and checkout experiences to drive sales in your retail store. Improve customer satisfaction with a seamless retail workflow.


📲 Sell Anywhere with POS Mobile

Manage sales from markets, street shops, or pop-up stores using just your mobile device. Flexibility to sell anywhere, anytime with Odoo POS!


💳 Seamless Payment Processing

Set up payment terminals, handle split payments, and integrate with various payment methods—ensuring fast, secure transactions both in restaurants and retail.


🖨 POS Hardware Integration

Configure receipt printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, kiosks, and customer displays for an optimized checkout process in both retail stores and restaurants.


🌍 Multi-Location Management

Effortlessly manage multiple stores or restaurant branches with centralized control. Ideal for chains or franchises to maintain consistent operations.


📊 Track and Analyze KPIs

Learn how to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for both restaurant and retail sales. Gain insights into performance and operational efficiency to make smarter decisions.

tracks.speaker_line: Ravi Thakkar, Malkesh Dutta, Himal Solanki, Kiran Borhade, Abhishek Reddy, Implementation Team Leader at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007


Prerequisites 

This training is intended for individuals who already have a strong understanding of Manufacturing from a business perspective and are familiar with implementing Odoo's Manufacturing applications. It is not suitable for beginners. 

Why Attend? 

If you're already using the Manufacturing, Shop Floor, and Quality​ applications but feel you're not maximizing their potential, the Manufacturing Master Class is the key to unlocking their full capabilities. This course blends business and functional knowledge with hands-on exercises, exploring diverse industry use cases and manufacturing processes, including Make-To-Order, Make-To-Stock, Assembly-To-Order, and Engineering-To-Order. You'll gain comprehensive expertise, from planning and utilizing our MES (Manufacturing Execution System) with the Shop Floor to managing in-house production or subcontracting, ensuring quality at every stage, and overseeing cost control. Looking for more? The course also includes a dynamic session on applying Kaizen principles with Odoo features, demonstrating how Lean Manufacturing can transform your business.

speakers.name: Ravi Thakkar, Malkesh Dutta, Himal Solanki, Kiran Borhade, Abhishek Reddy
speakers.biography_html:
A highly experienced cohort of Odoo Implementation Consultants and Team Leaders, this team brings deep domain expertise in manufacturing ERP—from inventory and routing to costing, helpdesk support, subcontracting, and analytic accounting. 

Ravi Thakkar brings extensive domain expertise in core MRP architecture, specializing in barcode-integrated data collection and scalable Bill of Materials (BOM) design. 

Malkesh Dutta brings deep background in demand forecasting, inventory optimization, Master Production Scheduling (MPS), and enterprise capacity planning strategies.

Himal Solanki is a specialist in total quality management (TQM), cross-app inventory synchronization, equipment maintenance protocols, and post-production repair workflows.

Kiran Borhade specializes in shop floor optimization, labor and work center efficiency tracking, external subcontracting logistics, and multi-tier product costing frameworks.

Abhishek Reddy focuses on advanced engineering management, with extensive experience driving Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Engineering Change Orders (ECO), and complex Engineer-To-Order (ETO) setups.

Together, they have executed numerous Odoo rollouts, delivering functional depth, hands-on training, and real-world manufacturing best practices geared toward driving operational excellence

Develop your own first module within the Odoo framework. This step-by-step tutorial is crafted for newcomers and any other individual curious about Odoo development.

Workshop Overview

Title: Introduction to development

Prerequisites

tracks.name: Master Class - Odoo Web Framework
tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007


Prerequisites

Attendees should have intermediate knowledge of Odoo and a basic understanding of javascript.

Why attend?


This year, Owl (Odoo’s javascript UI framework), has undergone a major refactoring. Owl 3 introduces a new reactivity model based on signals and a completely new plugin system. At the same time, many features have been simplified or redesigned, significantly changing how components are written, composed, and maintained. These changes improve correctness, performance, and long-term maintainability of UI code, but they also require non-trivial migrations for existing Owl applications. This training provides a hands-on, in-depth exploration of Owl 3, focusing on its core concepts—including signals, component lifecycle, rendering semantics, hooks, and plugins—and their practical usage within the Odoo web client.

Specifically, the training will cover:


-Owl 3.0: architecture and core concepts 
-The Odoo javascript framework design principles 
-Writing and organizing javascript code in the Odoo web client and website 
-Migration strategies from Owl 2.x to Owl 3.x

tracks.name: Master class - Advanced Point of Sale
tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007


Prerequisites

Participants should have a good understanding of Retail and Restaurant operations. A basic familiarity with Odoo’s Point of Sale (POS) system will be beneficial to fully engage with the advanced topics covered in this Smartclass.


Why should you attend?


✅ Participate in hands-on training – Gain practical experience using Odoo POS for retail and restaurant businesses.

✅ Engage in expert-led discussions – Learn from industry professionals and get direct answers to your questions.

✅ Discover best practices – Streamline operations and optimize sales with the latest Odoo features.

✅ Integrate seamlessly – Explore how Odoo POS connects with payment providers, delivery apps, and other hardware like printer, KIOSK and other integration too 

✅ Network with professionals – Exchange insights and strategies with business owners and Odoo experts.

✅ Experience the latest innovations – Get early access to Odoo’s newest POS features before a wider rollout.


During this 2-day Smartclass, you will discover:


🍽 Restaurant Order & Table Management

Streamline order-taking and manage tables efficiently for restaurants. Ensure a smooth and organized dining experience for both customers and staff.


🍽 Self Order management and Online Booking and waiting list management

Learn how to unify restaurant operations with self-ordering, real-time table bookings, and smart waiting list handling.

Enhance customer experience, reduce wait times, and optimize table management using modern POS solutions.

🚀 Swiggy & Zomato Integration

Automatically sync online food delivery orders with your Odoo POS system, reducing manual entry and ensuring more accurate, efficient order processing. This will save you time, reduce errors, and improve operational efficiency across your restaurant.


🛒 Boost Retail Sales

Learn how to manage product catalogs, promotions, and checkout experiences to drive sales in your retail store. Improve customer satisfaction with a seamless retail workflow.


📲 Sell Anywhere with POS Mobile

Manage sales from markets, street shops, or pop-up stores using just your mobile device. Flexibility to sell anywhere, anytime with Odoo POS!


💳 Seamless Payment Processing

Set up payment terminals, handle split payments, and integrate with various payment methods—ensuring fast, secure transactions both in restaurants and retail.


🖨 POS Hardware Integration

Configure receipt printers, barcode scanners, cash drawers, kiosks, and customer displays for an optimized checkout process in both retail stores and restaurants.


🌍 Multi-Location Management

Effortlessly manage multiple stores or restaurant branches with centralized control. Ideal for chains or franchises to maintain consistent operations.


📊 Track and Analyze KPIs

Learn how to track key performance indicators (KPIs) for both restaurant and retail sales. Gain insights into performance and operational efficiency to make smarter decisions.

tracks.name: Master Class -Odoo.sh & Vibe Coding (1 Day Class )
tracks.speaker_line: Soumya Mukherjee, Sr. Software Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007


OVERVIEW 


Discover how AI-assisted "vibe coding" transforms the way developers build on Odoo.sh — the cloud platform built for Odoo. In this hands-on session, we explore how to leverage AI coding tools (Claude, Anthropic Console, Amazon Bedrock, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, or Google Vertex AI) directly within an Odoo.sh development workflow to write modules faster, debug smarter, and deploy with confidence. Whether you're a seasoned Odoo developer or just getting started, this session will shift how you think about building on the platform. 

 WHAT YOU'LL LEARN  ?

  • Odoo.sh Fundamentals — branches, builds, staging vs. production
  • Vibe Coding Explained — what it is and why it's changing development
  • AI + Odoo.sh in Action — live demo: building a custom module using AI assistance
  • Best Practices — prompt engineering for Odoo models, views & controllers
  • Deploy with Confidence — review, test, and push AI-generated code responsibly

WHO SHOULD ATTEND ?

  • Odoo developers & technical consultants
  • Freelancers building Odoo customizations
  • Tech leads evaluating Odoo.sh adoption
  • Anyone curious about AI-driven ERP development

speakers.name: Soumya Mukherjee
speakers.biography_html:
Soumya is a developer in Odoo PS team, often found untangling “random slowness” that shows up at the worst possible time. He digs deep into logs, SQL, and ORM to hunt down performance issues that others write off as “just Odoo being Odoo.”

Before joining PS, he worked with the R&D BI team and has delivered major contributions for odoo's spreadsheet and dashboard modules, while currently contributing  custom modules and business flows for clients with big ideas and even bigger databases, always with a focus on stability and speed.

When things slow down, Soumya speeds up with logs, logic, and just enough caffeine.

He’s excited to take the stage and share the kind of lessons you only learn when everything breaks in production.

Build Your Own AI Agent

Create custom agents by defining roles, connecting documents, databases, and knowledge articles, and apply them to your unique business workflows like SDR, Legal, or Support.

The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007



Who is this Masterclass for?

This masterclass  is tailored for experienced Odoo users and implementing partners who are ready to:

  • Customize apps and screens without coding. 
  • Allows users to add fields, modify views, and automate workflows easily.
  • Master advanced reporting techniques in Odoo.
  • Leverage Spreadsheets to craft impactful dashboards.
  • Gain insights into best practices for Business Intelligence and performance optimization.

Prerequisites:

  • A strong foundation in Odoo applications is required.
  • Prior experience with Odoo Studio or Spreadsheets is recommended, but not mandatory.
  • A passion for data analysis and problem-solving.

Note: This masterclass is not suitable for beginners or those unfamiliar with Odoo Studio & spreadsheets.

Why Attend?

  • Be Ahead of the Curve: Get hands-on with the latest features of Odoo 19 before they’re released to the wider community.
  • Practical, Real-World Learning: Apply your new skills to real-life scenarios, from CRM pipeline analysis to cash flow forecasting and beyond.
  • Expert Guidance: Learn directly from Odoo Studio & BI Experts and gain exclusive tips, tools, and best practices.
  • Connect and Grow: Network with Odoo’s vibrant community and exchange ideas with experts and peers.

What you’ll learn:

This intensive training is designed to make you a data wizard. We’ll cover:

  • Customize forms, views, and menus without coding.

  • Create new apps and database models visually.

  • Automate workflows using triggers and server actions.

  • The Role of Business Intelligence in Odoo: Unleash the potential of your Odoo data.
  • Odoo Database Structure: Understand the foundations of data organization.
  • Excel Tips & Tricks: Master impactful formulas and techniques.
  • Data Insertion & Manipulation: Learn to clean, transform, and prepare data.
  • Visualization Techniques: Create stunning graphs, KPIs, and dashboards.
  • Access Rights & Sharing: Securely manage your data.
  • Best Practices & Advanced Tips: Avoid common pitfalls and optimize performance.
  • Use Case Applications: Solve real-world challenges such as CRM analysis, budgeting, and commission calculations.
  • Print Report Customization 
  • Approval rules on different models

tracks.description_html:
The Masterclass training will be conducted at the Odoo Gandhinagar office, India, on 9th & 10th September from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

    401 & 402, Floor 4, IT Tower 3 InfoCity Gate, 1, Gandhinagar, Gujarat 382007



Prerequisites 

This training is intended for individuals who already have a strong understanding of Manufacturing from a business perspective and are familiar with implementing Odoo's Manufacturing applications. It is not suitable for beginners. 

Why Attend? 

If you're already using the Manufacturing, Shop Floor and Quality​ applications but feel you're not maximizing their potential, the Manufacturing Master Class is the key to unlocking their full capabilities. This course blends business and functional knowledge with hands-on exercises, exploring diverse industry use cases and manufacturing processes, including Make-To-Order, Make-To-Stock, Assembly-To-Order, and Engineering-To-Order. You'll gain comprehensive expertise, from planning and utilizing our MES (Manufacturing Execution System) with the Shop Floor to managing in-house production or subcontracting, ensuring quality at every stage, and overseeing cost control. Looking for more? The course also includes a dynamic session on applying Kaizen principles with Odoo features, demonstrating how Lean Manufacturing can transform your business.

speakers.name: Ravi Thakkar, Malkesh Dutta, Himal Solanki, Kiran Borhade, Abhishek Reddy
speakers.biography_html:
A highly experienced cohort of Odoo Implementation Consultants and Team Leaders, this team brings deep domain expertise in manufacturing ERP—from inventory and routing to costing, helpdesk support, subcontracting, and analytic accounting. 

Ravi Thakkar brings extensive domain expertise in core MRP architecture, specializing in barcode-integrated data collection and scalable Bill of Materials (BOM) design. 

Malkesh Dutta brings deep background in demand forecasting, inventory optimization, Master Production Scheduling (MPS), and enterprise capacity planning strategies.

Himal Solanki is a specialist in total quality management (TQM), cross-app inventory synchronization, equipment maintenance protocols, and post-production repair workflows.

Kiran Borhade specializes in shop floor optimization, labor and work center efficiency tracking, external subcontracting logistics, and multi-tier product costing frameworks.

Abhishek Reddy focuses on advanced engineering management, with extensive experience driving Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Engineering Change Orders (ECO), and complex Engineer-To-Order (ETO) setups.

Together, they have executed numerous Odoo rollouts, delivering functional depth, hands-on training, and real-world manufacturing best practices geared toward driving operational excellence

Vivek Sanghi is a technology leader, entrepreneur, engineer, and the Co-Founder & COO of HashStudioz Technologies-an Odoo Authorized Partner and global product engineering consultancy. With over 20 years of IT industry leadership, Vivek combines deep technical architecture, growth strategy, and customer-centric design to scale enterprise solutions across more than 20 countries.

Throughout his career, Vivek has helped organizations modernize customer-facing processes, automate complex workflows, and build unified digital ecosystems leveraging Odoo, Salesforce, Cloud, AI/ML, and Industrial IoT.

He operates on a core philosophy: technology shouldn’t just innovate for novelty’s sake—it must make businesses agile, connected, and measurable.

At Odoo Experience 2026 India, Vivek presents a business-first approach to HeyDoot + Odoo, demonstrating how enterprises can transform WhatsApp into a fully connected sales, support, and CRM engine synced directly with their Odoo ecosystem.

After two decades in tech, Vivek continues to learn, experiment, and build what’s next.

tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Teesha Parwani, Business Support Analyst at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
I’m Teesha Parwani, a Functional Support Analyst at Odoo, where I’ve been working since 2025. In my role, I help customers troubleshoot functional issues, understand Odoo workflows, and make the most of Odoo’s features in their day-to-day operations.

What You'll Learn

Join this session to discover how Odoo’s Barcode Lookup can simplify and accelerate product creation. Instead of manually searching for product names, entering specifications, finding images, assigning categories, and configuring pricing, you’ll see how a simple barcode scan can automatically retrieve and populate essential product information.

We’ll walk through the complete process of creating a product using Barcode Lookup and explore how it can significantly reduce manual data entry while improving accuracy and consistency across your product catalog.

You’ll also see how a process that can take several minutes or even much longer when dealing with a large number of products can be reduced to just a few seconds with a single scan.

Who Should Attend

• Startups looking to quickly build and manage their product catalog
• Inventory and warehouse teams looking to speed up product creation
• Product managers managing large product catalogs
• Odoo users who want to reduce manual data entry
• Businesses with large product catalogs looking to scale their product management process

tracks.name: Legacy ERP to Odoo.sh: A Manufacturing & Trading Customer Success Story
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ved Shukla, Founder at Webanix Private Limited
tracks.description_html:
At Webanix Solutions, we believe an ERP should do more than digitize processes—it should transform the way a business operates. When our client, a manufacturing and trading company, approached us, they were facing challenges in managing production, inventory, sales, dealer incentives, logistics, and accounting through disconnected processes and manual workflows.

Their objective was clear: implement a single, scalable ERP solution capable of handling both standard operations and complex business-specific requirements. After understanding their processes in detail, we recommended Odoo.sh as the ideal platform, providing the flexibility to combine Odoo's robust standard features with custom developments tailored to their business.

The Challenge
Our client required a unified system that could:

  • Manage the complete manufacturing cycle from raw materials to finished goods.
  • Track inventory accurately across manufacturing and trading operations.
  • Integrate purchasing, sales, invoicing, and accounting into a single workflow.
  • Automate complex cash discount policies.
  • Calculate salesperson commissions based on quarterly and annual targets.
  • Manage dealer incentive programs linked to performance.
  • Build a structured sales hierarchy with team leaders and salespersons.
  • Generate automated daily sales reports for dealers and sales teams.
  • Handle scrap inventory without impacting operational stock while maintaining correct accounting treatment.
  • Maintain a centralized transporter database for trading operations.
  • Eliminate repetitive manual tasks through automation.
Our Solution
The Webanix Solutions team implemented a fully customized Odoo solution on Odoo.sh, covering the client's complete business lifecycle.
End-to-End ERP Implementation.
We successfully integrated:
  • Manufacturing
  • Inventory Management
  • Purchase Management
  • Sales Management
  • Accounting
  • CRM and Contact Management
This enabled every department to work from a single source of truth, providing real-time visibility into operations and financial performance.
Customized Sales Performance & Dealer Incentive Management.

To address the client's unique sales structure, we developed:
  • Quarterly and annual salesperson target management.
  • Automated commission calculations.
  • Dealer mapping within Odoo Contacts.
  • Performance-based dealer incentive calculations.
  • Transparent incentive tracking and reporting.
These customizations eliminated manual calculations, reduced errors, and significantly improved incentive management.
Sales Team Hierarchy & Automated Reporting. We designed a structured organizational hierarchy consisting of team leaders and salespersons, allowing performance to be monitored at every level. In addition, we automated daily sales reports that are shared with dealers and their respective salespersons, giving management real-time visibility into sales performance and enabling faster business decisions.

Advanced Inventory & Scrap Management
One of the client's key operational challenges involved scrap handling. Our team customized Odoo's scrap process so that scrap inventory is maintained separately without reducing operational inventory, while still generating the appropriate accounting impact. This provided more accurate inventory reporting, improved production analysis, and stronger financial control.

Logistics Management
For the client's trading business, we developed a centralized transporter database, enabling efficient management of transporter information and improving shipment planning and operational traceability.

Business Process Automation
We also automated several time-consuming daily processes, including:
  • Multiple cash discount rules
  • Cash rounding
  • Three-copy invoice PDF printing
  • Credit control rules
  • Additional workflow automations
These improvements reduced manual effort, minimized errors, and standardized operations across departments.

Business Outcomes
By partnering with Webanix Solutions, the client achieved:
  • A fully integrated ERP platform connecting manufacturing, inventory, procurement, sales, logistics, and finance.
  • Reduced manual work through intelligent automation.
  • Faster and more accurate commission and dealer incentive calculations.
  • Improved inventory visibility and financial accuracy.
  • Automated reporting that supports faster management decisions.
  • Stronger financial controls with customized accounting workflows.
  • Better collaboration across departments through centralized business data.
  • A scalable ERP platform capable of supporting future growth and evolving business requirements.
The Result
The implementation has transformed the client's day-to-day operations. Instead of relying on disconnected systems and manual processes, they now operate on a unified, intelligent ERP platform tailored to their business.

At Webanix Solutions, our focus goes beyond implementing software—we deliver business transformation. By combining Odoo's powerful capabilities with deep business process expertise and custom development, we helped our client improve operational efficiency, increase productivity, strengthen financial controls, and build a scalable digital foundation for long-term growth and measurable return on investment.

tracks.name: Digital Transformation of ISKCON Juhu: Unifying Donations, Events, Pooja Bookings, and Memberships with Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Amit Parik, Managing Partner at Browseinfo
tracks.description_html:
ISKCON is one of the largest NGOs in the world, with ISKCON Juhu (Mumbai) being one of its most prominent temples. Before adopting Odoo, the temple struggled with siloed systems and manual processes for managing donations, memberships, pooja bookings, e‑commerce, and accounting. Offline and online channels were disconnected, reporting was fragmented, and issuing compliant donation receipts (including 80G) was complex and time‑consuming.

In this session, I will present the end‑to‑end digital transformation we delivered for ISKCON Juhu using Odoo as the central platform. We gradually implemented Odoo across their core operations: online and offline donation management, membership programs (including more than 50,000 life patron members), event and pooja booking, e‑commerce for books such as the Bhagavad Gita, darshan scheduling and publishing on the website, and India‑specific accounting and compliance.

You’ll see how we designed a unified donor and devotee database, configured event and donation flows for specific religious occasions (such as Ekadashi, Annadana, and Go Seva), automated 80G receipt generation in one click, and integrated web, POS, and back‑office processes. The talk will focus on the functional design, implementation approach, and practical lessons learned that can be applied to NGOs, temples, and other donation‑driven organizations worldwide.

tracks.name: Odoo upgrades: Core concepts and tools
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3B, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Hiren Gohil, Upgrade Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Odoo upgrades involve much more than simply moving a database from an older version to a newer one. They require careful handling of database changes, custom modules, data migrations, and code compatibility.

In this talk, we will explore the core concepts behind Odoo upgrades and the tools available to make the upgrade process more reliable and efficient. We will cover how Odoo manages data updates, why upgrade scripts are needed, and how to write effective migration scripts.

Through practical examples, we will also explore the capabilities of upgrade-util, Odoo Upgrade Code scripts, and Upgrade Test Cases. The session will demonstrate common upgrade scenarios such as merging modules, installing new modules, renaming models and fields, changing field types, migrating data, and validating upgrade results.

This talk is designed for Odoo developers who want to better understand the upgrade process and learn practical techniques for handling customizations and complex data migrations across Odoo versions.

Key Learning:

  • Understand the fundamentals of Odoo database upgrades.

  • Learn why upgrade scripts are needed and how to write them.

  • Explore the upgrade-util library and its essential utilities.

  • Understand how Upgrade Code scripts help automate source code migration.

  • Learn how to test upgrade logic and validate data integrity.

tracks.name: Agentic AI-Driven SAP HANA to Odoo Migration at Scale with Zero-Downtime
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Om Prakash Maurya, Delivery Head at Ksolves India Ltd.
tracks.description_html:
As organizations outgrow the rigidity and rising costs of SAP HANA, Odoo is emerging as the strategic alternative, but migration is rarely straightforward.

This talk reveals how:
- AI intelligently maps SAP HANA data structures, flags field conflicts, and auto-generates assessment reports, dramatically reducing manual analysis effort.
- Agentic AI takes it further by autonomously orchestrating zero-downtime cutovers, continuously scoring migration risk, and escalating issues in real time, compressing go-live timelines to as little as weeks.
- Post-migration agents run autonomously in the background, monitoring data integrity and surfacing reconciliation gaps before they become production incidents, ensuring a smooth transition without requiring constant manual oversight.

Ideal for people and organizations that want to move away from SAP because of escalating costs but remain concerned about losing historical business data, disrupting operations, or undertaking a complex migration.

Key Learnings:
- The hidden cost of staying on SAP HANA, and the ROI case for switching.
- How AI agents compress a months-long migration into weeks without downtime.
- Real pitfalls, honest limitations, and what actually makes a go-live succeed.

tracks.description_html:
What You'll Learn


Join this session to explore how Odoo Controllers serve and deliver website content. We will look at how to define routes, handle HTTP requests, render QWeb templates, and expose functionality through JSON-RPC controllers.

You will also see how the backend and frontend communicate, with a practical demonstration of calling JSON-RPC controllers from JavaScript using Odoo's modern Interactions framework.

Whether you're building custom website pages, exposing backend functionality to the frontend, or simply want to understand what happens behind the scenes when a request reaches an Odoo website, this session will give you a practical understanding of Odoo's web framework.

If you're a developer looking to build powerful and interactive websites in Odoo, this talk is for you.

  • Developers looking to build or customize website pages

  • Developers working with QWeb templates and server-side rendering
  • Developers curious about how the Odoo Web Framework works behind the scenes
  • Tech leads managing website and frontend customization at scale

tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3B, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Shrut Pansuriya, Offshore Team Lead at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
What You'll Learn

Join this session to explore how to make the most out of Odoo.sh — Odoo’s development and deployment platform.

We’ll start by understanding what Odoo.sh is and how it fits between SaaS and On-Premise deployments, before exploring the development, staging, and production workflow. You’ll learn how projects, branches, and builds work together, and how changes move from development to testing and finally to production.

We’ll also look at the tools available to developers, including the Odoo.sh shell, editor, logs, monitoring, backups, and other features that make development and troubleshooting easier.

Finally, we’ll explore the new AI capabilities and vibe coding, and see how AI can help developers build faster while keeping development, testing, and deployment under control.

Whether you’re new to Odoo.sh or already using it, this session will give you a practical understanding of how to work effectively with the platform.

Who Should Attend

  • Odoo Developers looking to develop, test, and deploy custom Odoo modules on Odoo.sh

  • Technical Leads managing Odoo development and deployment workflows

  • Odoo Implementers and Consultants looking to better understand the development lifecycle on Odoo.sh

  • Developers working with custom modules, third-party integrations, and Git-based Odoo development

  • Teams looking to improve their development, testing, and deployment practices

  • Developers curious about Odoo.sh’s new AI capabilities and vibe coding

tracks.speaker_line: Mahmud Saiyed, Product Owner at TechUltra Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
tracks.description_html:
The printing industry is rapidly evolving toward personalization, automation, and digital-first customer experiences. In this session, we'll explore how Odoo can be extended beyond traditional eCommerce to become a comprehensive Web-to-Print, Print-on-Demand, Product Personalization, and Print ERP platform.

Drawing from real-world implementation experience, we'll discuss the architecture, challenges, and key design decisions behind building an enterprise-grade solution that combines an interactive product designer, AI-powered creative tools, dynamic pricing, print-ready file generation, production workflows, manufacturing integration, dropshipping, and seamless eCommerce connectivity - all within the Odoo ecosystem.

Attendees will learn how modern print businesses can enable customers to personalize products online with live previews, text, images, QR codes, variable data printing (VDP), and AI-assisted design capabilities while automating sales, manufacturing, fulfillment, and production workflows using standard Odoo applications.

Key Takeaways
How to build an enterprise-grade Web-to-Print platform on Odoo.
Best practices for product personalization and online design experiences.
Integrating AI into the print customization workflow.
Managing complex pricing models, print methods, and production processes.
Connecting eCommerce, Sales, Inventory, MRP, and Manufacturing into a unified workflow.
Seamless integration with Shopify, WooCommerce and other eCommerce platforms.
Lessons learned from developing a scalable solution for modern print and personalized product businesses.

Whether you're an Odoo partner, developer, or business looking to expand into the print industry, this session will provide practical insights into building scalable, industry-specific solutions that unlock new business opportunities on the Odoo platform.

How to build an enterprise-grade Web-to-Print platform on Odoo.

Lessons learned from developing a scalable solution for modern print and personalized product businesses.

See a practical end-to-end demonstration of how Odoo POS and UrbanPiper can simplify restaurant operations by bringing online and offline orders into a single system.

Whether you are an Odoo developer, consultant, restaurant owner, or technology enthusiast, this session will give you a clear understanding of how food delivery integrations can work seamlessly with Odoo POS.
​

tracks.name: From Farm to Factory: End-to-End Agri Operations with Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Parth Ghediya, Project Delivery Head at Caret IT Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
tracks.description_html:
Agriculture businesses often focus on contract farming and procurement, but the real challenge begins after harvest. Managing farmer contracts, procurement, crop planning, quality inspections, logistics, cold storage, supply-chain, inventory, manufacturing, settlements, and traceability across multiple stakeholders can quickly become complex and difficult to scale.

In this session, we will showcase how Odoo enterprise has used to build an end-to-end Farm-to-Factory platform for a large potato ecosystem, connecting contract farming, procurement, quality management, warehouse operations, cold storage, manufacturing, and financial processes within a single integrated system.

The talk will cover the complete business journey from farmer on-boarding and crop planning to harvest collection, quality grading, inventory management, processing, and final customer delivery. We will also demonstrate how operational challenges such as multi-parameter quality inspections, freight management, storage visibility, landed costing, and end-to-end traceability were addressed using Odoo.

Through a real-world implementation case study based on SK Group, one of India's leading potato ecosystem businesses, attendees will learn how agricultural businesses can eliminate disconnected systems, improve operational visibility, standardize processes, and create a single source of truth across the entire supply chain. We will share the business challenges faced during the digital transformation, the architectural decisions taken, and how Odoo was successfully adapted to support complex agricultural operations at enterprise scale.

What's next: We will present the future roadmap of the project as SK Group expands into food manufacturing. The next phase focuses on extending the same Odoo platform to manage manufacturing operations, enabling a seamless transition from agricultural procurement to finished food production while maintaining complete traceability, operational visibility, and financial control.

Who should attend: Agricultural enterprises, food processing and manufacturing companies, agritech startups, supply chain and manufacturing leaders, agricultural engineers, Odoo Partners, functional consultants, business analysts, ERP decision-makers, and organizations looking to build an end-to-end Farm-to-Factory solution on Odoo.

Key Takeaways
Optimize operations form farm-to-factory using odoo
Managing contract farming and procurement at scale
Implementing quality, logistics, storage, and traceability processes across the Farm-to-Factory supply chain
Single platform for Integrated operations, inventory, manufacturing, and finance
How we reduced order processing time by 40%

tracks.name: Getting Started with OWL: Build Reactive Web Application
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Dhrutik Patel, Software Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
What You’ll Learn

Join this session to understand how OWL, the Odoo Web Library, helps developers build structured, reusable, and reactive user interfaces inside Odoo.

We’ll start with the basic building blocks of OWL, including components, templates, rendering context, events, setup, props, and slots. Then we’ll move into important OWL 3 concepts such as signals, proxy, computed values, effects, plugins, references, and lifecycle hooks.

You’ll also get a simple explanation of how OWL works behind the scenes, how reactive updates keep the UI in sync with state, and how these concepts can be used to build modern web applications in Odoo.

If you’re a developer who wants to understand OWL clearly and start building reactive UI in Odoo, this talk is for you.


Who Should Attend

  • Developers working with the Odoo web client

  • Developers who want to learn OWL from the basics

  • Frontend developers interested in reactive UI patterns

  • Odoo developers who want to understand OWL 3 concepts

  • Developers curious about how OWL works behind the scenes

tracks.name: Integrate OWL in Odoo: Odoo’s JavaScript Framework
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Darpan Daswani, Research and development software developer. at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Integrate OWL in Odoo: Odoo’s JavaScript Framework

About the Session

You’ve learned the basics of OWL → now it’s time to understand how OWL fits into the bigger picture of Odoo’s JavaScript framework.

This session will take you beyond standalone OWL concepts and show how Odoo builds its frontend architecture around OWL, Views, Fields, Widgets, services, and the end-to-end request flow. You’ll learn how these pieces connect and how to approach frontend development in Odoo from an application and framework perspective.

What You’ll Learn

By the end of this session, you’ll understand:

  • How Odoo’s JavaScript framework is structured and where OWL fits into it

  • The key concepts and architecture behind Odoo’s frontend framework

  • Why knowing OWL alone isn’t enough to build and customise Odoo’s frontend effectively

  • How Views, Fields, and Widgets work within Odoo

  • The end-to-end request flow, from a user action in the browser to the backend and back

  • How to connect the concepts learned in OWL with real-world Odoo frontend development

Why Should You Attend?

If you already know the fundamentals of OWL, this session will help you bridge the gap between learning a frontend framework and understanding Odoo’s frontend framework.

You’ll gain a clearer picture of how Odoo’s JavaScript ecosystem works as a whole, making it easier to:

  • Develop and customise Odoo frontend features

  • Understand existing Odoo frontend code

  • Work with Views, Fields, and Widgets

Eligibility / Prerequisite

Prerequisite: Completion of the OWL session.

This session assumes that you are already familiar with the basics of OWL. We will not cover OWL fundamentals in detail; instead, we’ll build on that knowledge to explore how OWL is integrated into Odoo’s JavaScript framework.

Agenda

  1. Overview

  2. Basics of OWL Framework

  3. Why OWL Isn’t Enough?

  4. Odoo’s JavaScript Framework

  5. Views

  6. Fields & Widgets

  7. End-to-End Request Flow

Who Should Attend?

This session is ideal for Developers who want to move beyond OWL fundamentals and understand how Odoo’s frontend architecture works in practice.

Complete the OWL session first → then join us to see how OWL comes together with the rest of Odoo’s JavaScript framework.

tracks.description_html:

tracks.name: How OdooPIM Turns Product Data into Retail Growth
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Dipali H, PIM Evangelist and Product Lead, OdooPIM at Navabrind IT Solutions Pvt Ltd
tracks.description_html:
Retailers today manage product information manually across multiple systems, marketplaces, websites, and sales channels. This results in product data being inconsistent, incomplete, or outdated. The result, delayed product launches, poor customer experiences, and often times, lost sales. As product catalogs continue to grow, maintaining accurate and synchronized product information becomes an even greater challenge. 

This session explores how OdooPIM solves the problem of disconnected product data and how as an Odoo-native Product Information Management (PIM) solution it transforms product data management with automation for accuracy and speed. 

Attendees will discover how retailers can centralize product information, automate data enrichment, and publish consistent product content across every sales channel, all from within Odoo. 

The presentation will showcase how OdooPIM enables retailers to: 

● Create a single source of truth for all product information. 

● Reduce the time required to onboard and launch new products. ● Improve product data quality with AI-powered enrichment. 

● Synchronize accurate product information across eCommerce stores, marketplaces, POS, and ERP. 

Using a case study, we'll walk through the challenges faced by a growing retailer, the solution architecture, implementation approach, measurable business outcomes, and key lessons learned. 

Attendees will leave with insights on how OdooPIM helps users modernize product data management, improve omnichannel consistency, accelerate time-to-market, and improve sales with an Odoo-native PIM solution.

tracks.name: Testing your code in Odoo: Why and how should you do it?
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Arib Ansari, Odoo Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
How do you know your Odoo code will keep working tomorrow?

In this talk, we’ll explore the main testing tools available in Odoo and, more importantly, when to use each one.

We’ll look at Hoot for testing frontend JavaScript, Python Unittest for backend logic and real Odoo data, and Tours for verifying complete user workflows. Along the way, we’ll see how to create and run each type of test through practical examples and demos.

By the end, you’ll have a clear picture of which testing approach fits your code, how to write it, and how to run it—so that the bugs you fix today don’t quietly come back tomorrow.

tracks.name: From Automation to Autonomy: Building Agentic AI Workflows Inside Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Prerak Mehta, Sr. Odoo Consultant at KoderXpert Technologies LLP
tracks.description_html:
Abstract
The ERP landscape is undergoing its most profound transformation in decades. Traditional automation — rule-based, trigger-driven, and brittle — is giving way to a new paradigm: Agentic AI, where intelligent systems don't just execute instructions, but sense context, reason through exceptions, and take coordinated action across modules without constant human intervention.
This session explores how Odoo partners and businesses can architect and deploy AI agents natively within the Odoo ecosystem to unlock the next level of ERP performance. We move beyond chatbots and copilots to examine real-world patterns where AI agents manage lead qualification, supplier negotiations, inventory exceptions, invoice approvals, and support ticket resolution — autonomously and measurably.
Attendees will learn how Odoo's modular architecture, role-based security, and audit framework create an ideal foundation for controlled autonomy: giving AI agents enough context and capability to eliminate repetitive decision-making, while preserving human approval for high-risk actions. We will also address the practical realities: why data hygiene is the non-negotiable prerequisite, how to avoid the common pitfall of deploying AI on top of poorly configured workflows, and how to measure ROI not by the number of prompts submitted, but by operational KPIs.
Whether you are an Odoo implementer, a business owner evaluating AI investments, or a developer building custom modules, this session will give you a concrete architectural roadmap and a go-live checklist for building autonomous, self-optimizing Odoo workflows — today.

Key Takeaways:
• Understand the three dominant AI agent deployment patterns inside Odoo (Sidecar, Embedded, and Gateway)
• Learn when traditional Odoo automation is better than AI agents — and when it isn't
• See live demonstrations of agentic workflows across Sales, Inventory, Finance, and Support
• Get a practical governance and security framework for controlled autonomy
• Walk away with a phased implementation roadmap for your own Odoo environment

speakers.name: Prerak Mehta
speakers.biography_html:
Prerak Mehta
Business Analyst & Sr. ERP Consultant | AI-Driven Business Solutions

Prerak Mehta is a Business Analyst and ERP Consultant who brings a rare combination of enterprise consulting depth, genuine entrepreneurial experience, and hands-on exposure to modern AI-driven workflows. With 5 years of dedicated experience as a business analyst and ERP consultant, he specializes in translating complex operational realities into clean, scalable ERP solutions.

What truly sets Prerak apart is the 7 to 8 years of real-world business experience he brings prior to his consulting career. He has manufactured spare parts for vehicles, including motors and accessories, giving him direct exposure to production floors, supply chains, and inventory operations. He has run a retail clothing business, which sharpened his instincts around sales, merchandising, and customer behavior. He has also worked inside a chemical manufacturing company, adding process-driven industry knowledge to his portfolio. This lived experience means Prerak does not just map requirements to modules; he thinks like the business owner sitting across the table, because he has been that business owner.

Alongside his ERP expertise, Prerak has built strong practical experience with AI and agentic workflows in the business context. He has explored the integration of AI agents into ERP processes to automate repetitive tasks such as data entry, invoice reconciliation, lead qualification, and reporting. He has hands-on exposure to LLM-powered assistants for enhancing decision support inside Odoo, and has contributed to designing agentic workflows that reduce manual bottlenecks in sales, procurement, and inventory cycles. His approach combines business logic with AI capability, ensuring that automation solves the real problem rather than just adding technology for its own sake.

Prerak is known for his excellent communication skills and strong business acumen, which allow him to bridge the gap between stakeholders, developers, and end users with clarity and confidence. He is comfortable running discovery sessions, translating business pain points into structured requirements, and guiding clients through implementation with a practical, outcome-first mindset.

At KoderXpert, Prerak is positioned as the go-to consultant for clients who want an advisor with genuine skin in the business game, backed by both traditional ERP mastery and forward-looking AI capability. For any organization looking to modernize operations through Odoo ERP and intelligent automation, Prerak offers the rare mix of empathy, expertise, and execution that turns technology into measurable business value.

speakers.name: Tiru Chembeti
speakers.biography_html:
Tiru Chembeti is a Finance and ERP transformation leader with 15+ years of experience spanning finance, auditing, ERP implementation, and digital transformation. He has over 11 years of experience working with ERP platforms, leading strategic ERP implementations and transformation initiatives across manufacturing, distribution, professional services, logistics, construction, and finance.

He currently serves as Vice President – ERP Product Development & Professional Services at Reachware, where he leads ERP product strategy, roadmap planning, development execution, and customer-focused solutions. His experience includes implementing and optimizing ERP platforms such as Odoo, ERPNext, and Oracle l NetSuite for organizations across multiple industries and geographies.

Tiru has designed and developed custom ERP products and solutions addressing complex business and compliance requirements, including VAT/GST/TDS automation, advanced budgeting, subcontracting management, property and equipment management, lease management, AR/AP netting, and IFRS reporting.

He holds professional certifications including CMA and CA, along with certifications in ERP, Professional Accounting, SuiteFoundation, Advanced Revenue Management, Multi-Book Accounting, and functional consulting certifications for Odoo and ERPNext.

With a strong combination of finance expertise, ERP knowledge, and hands-on implementation experience, Tiru brings practical, real-world insights into ERP transformation, implementation challenges, and how organizations can leverage ERP systems to build scalable and efficient business processes.

tracks.location: Convention Hall 1, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ankur Joshi, Product Owner at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
What This Talk Is All About

This 30 minute product demonstration showcases how Odoo Construction Industry connects every phase of a construction project, from initial sales bids to on-site execution and final financial closeout.

Told through a real-world scenario, the talk addresses the biggest operational headaches facing general contractors today: inaccurate bidding, lost blueprints, unbilled change orders, paper timesheets, and delayed month-end billing.

Why You Should Attend

  • See Real Margin Protection in Action: Learn how built-in quotation calculators, explicit contract rules (Fixed Price vs. Open Book), and automated cost alerts stop profit loss before a project even begins.

  • Eliminate Office-to-Field Friction: Discover how confirming a sale instantly creates project tasks, centralizes CAD drawings/permits, and auto-generates a Material Shopping List without manual data re-keying.

  • Master Field Productivity & Cash Flow: See live demonstrations of mobile crew scheduling, site quality remark tracking, instant change order logging, and streamlined Progress Billing that turns work completed on-site into consolidated client invoices in minutes.

  • Gain Real-Time Financial Visibility: Understand how executive dashboards aggregate live labor hours, supplier bills, and progress billing so you can monitor true job profitability while the project is still active.
