tracks.name: More Than an ERP: Building an Odoo System Your Teams Actually Use
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3A, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Parag Agrawal, Co-founder and Chief Operating Officer at iProgrammer Solutions Private Limited
tracks.description_html:
Implementing Odoo is not only about configuring modules, migrating data, and completing a go-live. The real measure of success is whether employees use the system confidently, whether business processes become simpler, and whether management gains better control, visibility, and decision-making.

Many organizations invest in ERP systems but continue to depend on spreadsheets, manual approvals, offline communication, and duplicate data entry. In such cases, the software may be technically live, but the business has not truly adopted it.

This talk explains how organizations can move from ERP implementation to business impact. It focuses on designing Odoo around real user roles, daily activities, process challenges, and expected business outcomes. The session will cover how to simplify workflows, reduce unnecessary data entry, improve usability, involve employees during implementation, validate real-life business scenarios, and deliver role-specific training.

The talk will also introduce the outcome-ownership principles behind ORBIT, iProgrammer’s approach to ensuring that Odoo continues to deliver value after go-live. This includes reviewing system health, identifying adoption gaps, improving workflows, measuring usage, and creating a continuous improvement roadmap.

Attendees will learn how to ensure that Odoo becomes the system through which the business actually operates, rather than an application used only for recording transactions.

The session is intended for business owners, senior management, ERP sponsors, department heads, process owners, finance leaders, operations teams, and organizations planning or currently undergoing an Odoo implementation.

Key Learnings
How to define ERP success beyond technical go-live
Why employees return to spreadsheets and manual processes
How to design Odoo around real user needs and business roles
How to reduce unnecessary data entry and improve usability
How to build employee confidence and improve adoption
How to measure whether Odoo is delivering business value
How continuous improvement can protect long-term ERP investment

tracks.description_html:

tracks.name: Product Costing and Manufacturing Cost Analysis
tracks.location: Convention Hall 1, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Manas Goswami, Business Support Analyst at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Know Your Speaker

Manas Goswami Odoo Functional Expert | Operations & Inventory Valuation Specialist | Business Support Analyst 

Manas Goswami is a proven Odoo Functional Expert with 3 years of hands-on experience across Inventory, Manufacturing, Purchase, and Inventory Valuation. He specializes in helping manufacturing businesses move past operational friction — the kind that creeps in when procurement, production, and finance don't talk to each other.

Passionate about empowering manufacturing companies to run leaner and smarter, Manas brings deep, practical expertise in designing and implementing ERP solutions across Procurement, Inventory Management, Logistics & Supply Chain, and Inventory Valuation.

About the Session: Product Costing and Manufacturing Cost Analysis

Manufacturing costs are rarely as simple as they look on paper — labour, overhead, and material costs often overlap in ways that make it hard to know your true cost per unit. This session breaks down the fundamentals of product costing and manufacturing cost analysis: what actually makes up your cost, why planned costs (like BoM) often diverge from real costs (like actual Manufacturing Orders), and where those gaps typically come from.

We'll walk through the key cost buckets, how routing and production decisions influence final costs, and how a connected ERP system, Odoo, can bring clarity to the whole process through a live demo. Whether you're in operations, finance, or manufacturing, you'll leave with a clearer framework for pricing your products with confidence.

Join this session to explore how integrating conversational AI directly into Odoo CRM eliminates repetitive outreach, speeds up your quotation workflow, and frees up your sales team to focus strictly on closing high-value deals.

tracks.name: From Mine to Money: Digitising a Limestone Mining Enterprise with Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Saurav Kumar, CEO at Technogeo Soft Solution Pvt. Ltd
tracks.description_html:
A limestone mining enterprise is far more than a production operation. Behind every ton of finished material lies a connected journey involving production planning, extraction, fleet movement, fuel consumption, maintenance, inventory, procurement, weighbridge operations, dispatch, invoicing and finance.

Before Odoo, these activities were managed through separate records, documents and departmental processes. Although the business was operationally interconnected, its information remained fragmented. Management could see production quantities and individual transactions but lacked a continuous view of material movement, stage-wise costs, inventory value and profitability.

This session presents how Odoo became the digital backbone of the enterprise, connecting the complete journey from mine planning to customer payment. It demonstrates how production became traceable, fleet utilisation and fuel costs became measurable, maintenance shifted from breakdown response to planned reliability, inventory became visible working capital, and procurement became controlled and budget-linked. It also shows how gate entry, weighbridge, dispatch, invoicing and accounting were integrated into one commercially validated transaction trail.

Attendees will learn how an integrated Odoo implementation can connect complex industrial operations, establish cost-per-ton visibility and translate every physical movement into measurable financial performance—from mine to money.

speakers.name: Saurav Kumar
speakers.biography_html:
Saurav Kumar is a Business and Digital Transformation Consultant with nearly 22 years of experience helping organizations simplify complex operations and turn technology into measurable business value.

As the Founder and CEO of GeoTechnoSoft, he has led transformation initiatives across mining, manufacturing, government, rural development and service enterprises. His work connects every layer of a business—from operations, inventory, procurement and logistics to finance, customer management and strategic decision-making.

His transformation philosophy is simple: technology alone does not transform an organization—people, processes and purpose do. ERP, data analytics, automation and AI become powerful only when they are aligned with real business challenges.

More recently, Saurav has been helping organizations move beyond conventional digitization by integrating AI into business operations, decision-making and customer experiences.

Through the CIS “Mine to Money” transformation, he demonstrates how a traditionally operated limestone mining enterprise was connected digitally—from extraction and processing to inventory, sales, invoicing and payment—creating greater visibility, accountability and control across the organization.

tracks.name: Manage Your Bakery Business Effortlessly with Odoo PoS
tracks.location: Convention Hall 2, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Kunal Ahuja, Functional Support Analyst at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
What You'll Learn 
Running a bakery is a delicate balancing act: managing fast-paced sales, tracking high-variety inventory, satisfying changing customer cravings, and keeping display cases stocked without blowing up daily wastage.

This session delivers a practical roadmap for using Odoo PoS to streamline every aspect of your front-counter and backend operations:

  • Speed & Efficiency: Master quick billing, flexible payment options, and seamless queue management during peak rush hours.

  • Smart Upselling & Pricing: Drive higher average bill values using automated price lists, promotional discounts, and strategic product recommendations at checkout.

  • Real-Time Visibility: Monitor live sales, track top-performing baked goods, and analyze customer buying patterns on the fly.

  • Waste & Stock Control: Sync sales with inventory to prevent stockouts of crowd favorites while minimizing costly overproduction.

Through a real-world bakery scenario, you’ll see firsthand how Odoo PoS solves common daily headaches—from long lines and inventory gaps to missed revenue opportunities.

Who Should Attend

  • Bakery Owners & Managers looking to streamline sales operations and protect their margins.

  • Retail Operations Teams aiming to speed up checkout and elevate the customer experience.

  • Existing Odoo Users eager to unlock the full potential of Odoo PoS for food and beverage retail.

  • Entrepreneurs & Consultants curious about scaling fast-paced bakery businesses with modern software.

tracks.name: ERP Is Not Software

tracks.speaker_line: Sanjeev Aggarwal, Business Head at AGBE Technology Solutions Private Limited
tracks.description_html:
Most ERP discussions focus on features, modules, and technology. Yet many businesses continue to struggle with delayed decisions, poor data quality, operational firefighting, inventory inefficiencies, and lack of visibility even after implementing an ERP system.

In this session, Sanjeev Aggarwal, Founder of Agbe India and Enterprise Transformation Advisor, shares practical lessons from leading digital transformation initiatives across manufacturing, automotive, distribution, healthcare, and service organizations. Drawing from real-world Odoo implementations, the session explores why ERP success is rarely a software problem and is more often a challenge of governance, data discipline, process ownership, change management, and leadership alignment.

Attendees will learn the seven operational disciplines that separate successful ERP journeys from failed or underutilised implementations. The session will showcase practical examples of how organizations used Odoo to improve visibility, streamline operations, reduce manual effort, strengthen decision-making, and build scalable operating models.

Whether you are a business owner, CIO, COO, CFO, operations leader, or implementation partner, this session will provide actionable insights to help ensure that your ERP becomes a platform for business growth rather than just another software project.

What You'll Learn

Join this session to understand how Odoo Spreadsheet and Dashboard performance works and how your design choices can affect speed and storage.

We’ll understand how the Odoo Spreadsheet and Dashboard architecture works, along with the recent architectural improvements that make spreadsheets and dashboards faster and more scalable. We’ll also look at how data volume, formulas, and dashboard structure can affect performance.

The discussion will cover common performance bottlenecks and how to identify them, as well as practical ways for developers, consultants, and end users to improve performance. Finally, we’ll explore how to reduce storage usage and build dashboards that are faster, more efficient, and easier to maintain.

  • Developers building or customizing Odoo Spreadsheet and Dashboard features
  • Business advisers and functional consultants designing dashboards and reports
  • Users creating or maintaining Odoo Spreadsheets and Dashboards
  • Anyone working with large or complex datasets or interested in how design and configuration choices affect performance and storage

tracks.name: The Most Common Security Pitfalls
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Harsh Shah, AI Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Security vulnerabilities don't always come from complex attacks - they often come from simple mistakes.

In this talk, we'll explore some of the most common security pitfalls developers encounter while developing and customizing Odoo, along with practical examples of how these issues can be introduced and, more importantly, how to avoid them.

We'll look at common mistakes such as trusting user-controlled data, improper access control, unsafe handling of inputs, and other security issues that can easily slip into everyday development. The goal is to help developers recognize these patterns early and build applications that are secure by design.

Whether you're a developer looking to strengthen your security fundamentals or someone who wants to understand how seemingly small implementation decisions can lead to serious vulnerabilities, this talk will give you practical takeaways you can apply to your own projects.

tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Aditya Sharma, Software Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
JavaScript Performance: From Browser Internals to Practical Optimizations


Join Aditya from Odoo’s R&D SM team for a practical session on understanding and improving JavaScript performance in modern web applications.

Performance problems are not always caused by “slow JavaScript”. Sometimes the real issue is how our code interacts with the browser, the main thread, rendering, memory, and asynchronous work.

In this session, we’ll build that mental model and explore 7 practical performance mantras:

With real JavaScript and OWL examples, we'll look at what actually makes an application feel slow and, more importantly, how to make it faster.

Whether you're building Odoo interfaces every day or simply want a better understanding of JavaScript performance, you'll leave with practical techniques and a mental model you can apply immediately.

Let’s make JavaScript fast, not just clever.

tracks.name: Selling Odoo as a New Partner: Lessons from the Trenches
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ashutosh Sharma, Director at i8CLOUD
tracks.description_html:
Landing your first Odoo client is brutal. No case studies, no referrals, no proof. Just you, a demo environment, and a prospect who has never heard of Odoo.
This talk is for new implementation partners who have sat across a business owner and realized mid-pitch that you are not just selling software - you are selling a concept. Odoo is not Tally. It is not SAP. It does not sell itself.
We share our early struggle honestly: the outreach that went nowhere, the demos that excited but never converted, and the moment we realized we were chasing the wrong businesses entirely. Then the practical fix: how we defined our ICP for the Indian market, why educating before pitching is the only approach that works, and what finally got us our first signed deal.
This is for a new partner trying to figure out where to even start.

Key learnings:

- Why Odoo needs an education-first sales approach
- How to define your ICP with no track record and no niche
- Outreach and positioning tactics that work from day one
- Shifting from "selling software" to "selling transformation"

tracks.name: Beyond the Cold Call: Building an Empathy-Aware AI Voice Agent Inside Odoo CRM
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Srikanthbalaji NM, CEO at GSUS Star Software Solutions Private Limited
tracks.description_html:
Most outbound sales calling still runs on scripted IVRs or whichever BDE has bandwidth that hour — leads go cold waiting for a human to dial. This talk walks through a solution architecture that puts an AI voice agent directly inside Odoo CRM's lead lifecycle: the agent places the first outbound call over VoIP, holds a natural conversation shaped by real-time emotion detection, qualifies the lead against a configurable framework, and automatically creates a task and assigns a human Business Development Executive the moment a lead is demo-ready.

The talk covers the practical build: triggering calls from CRM lead states, integrating a VoIP provider with Odoo's activity and task models, structuring an empathy-and-emotion scoring layer, and closing the loop by recording, transcribing, and grounding every call — AI-led and human-led — so both the agent and the sales team keep improving from real conversations.

Attendees will leave with a reusable pattern for combining Odoo CRM automation with voice AI, a framework for scoring conversational quality beyond simple call-outcome tracking, and lessons on where AI should qualify versus where a human should close. Aimed at Odoo partners, functional consultants, and sales-ops leaders exploring AI-augmented CRM workflows.

tracks.speaker_line: Yash Panchal, Implementation Consultant at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Yash joined Odoo in January 2023 as a Business Analyst before transitioning into his current role as an Implementation Consultant. Throughout his journey, he has contributed to several key initiatives, including pre-sales, Live Chat, and go-live support. These diverse experiences have given him a broad understanding of the customer journey from identifying business needs and recommending the right solutions to implementing Odoo and supporting customers through a successful go-live.


Every lead represents a potential opportunity, but converting it begins with one crucial decision: Who should handle it? As lead volumes grow, manual assignment can delay responses, create uneven workloads, increase the possibility of errors, and make the entire process dependent on a sales manager.

Join this practical session to discover how Odoo can transform lead distribution into a smarter, rule-based process. Learn how leads can be assigned using business criteria such as customer location, lead source, expected revenue, customer interest, salesperson eligibility, workload, and availability. We will also explore how rotation, capacity limits, and assignment priorities help distribute opportunities more effectively.

See how Odoo can help your sales team respond faster, work more efficiently, and ensure that the right lead reaches the right salesperson at the right time.

Don’t miss this opportunity to move beyond manual distribution and unlock a smarter approach to lead assignment with Odoo!

tracks.name: Inventory Management for Perishable Goods
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3A, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ishaan Desai, Business Support Analyst at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Ishaan Desai is a Business Support Analyst at Odoo who enjoys turning complex inventory challenges into practical, easy-to-understand solutions.

In a world where products have an expiry date, inventory isn’t just about quantities; it’s about timing, traceability, freshness, and making every stock movement count. From managing expiry dates and product traceability to reducing waste and improving stock visibility, Ishaankumar focuses on helping businesses make their inventory processes smarter and more efficient with Odoo.

What started as solving real business problems every day has now become an opportunity to share those learnings with the wider Odoo community.

Join Ishaan for an insightful session on smarter inventory management and discover how the right Odoo flows can help reduce waste, improve stock visibility, and ensure every product movement is managed at the right time.

tracks.name: From Excel to Smart Factory: Manufacturing Transformation Journey
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ganesan Chandrasekaran and Balabhuvaneshwaran, Vice President - Business & Deliveries and Head - Business Deliveries at PINNACLE SEVEN TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED
tracks.description_html:
From Excel to Smart Factory: Manufacturing Transformation Journey
• Digital transformation is no longer about replacing legacy systems—it's about
enabling manufacturers to make faster decisions, improve operational agility, and
create a connected enterprise.
• In this session, we will present the transformation journey of Coimbatore Potteries &
Refractories (CPR), illustrating how a traditional manufacturing organization evolved
from spreadsheet-driven operations to an integrated, data-driven manufacturing
ecosystem powered by Odoo.
• Rather than focusing solely on technology, this session explores the business strategy
behind the transformation, the challenges of organizational change, the
implementation approach, and the measurable operational impact achieved through
process standardization, real-time visibility, and intelligent decision-making.
• Attendees will gain practical insights into how manufacturers can successfully
modernize their operations while building a scalable digital foundation for future
growth.

Key Points We Will Cover
• The limitations of Excel-driven manufacturing operations
• Recognizing the need for digital transformation in a growing manufacturing business
• Building a connected manufacturing ecosystem with Odoo
• Standardizing business processes across departments
• Achieving real-time visibility into production, inventory, procurement, quality, and
finance
• Driving operational excellence through data-driven decision making
• Change management and user adoption in manufacturing environments
• Key business outcomes, lessons learned, and best practices for successful ERP
transformation
• The roadmap from ERP implementation to a Smart Factory vision

Why This Talk Is Relevant
• Many manufacturers continue to rely on spreadsheets and disconnected systems that
limit visibility, efficiency, and scalability. As businesses embrace Industry 4.0, the
ability to integrate operations, standardize processes, and leverage real-time data has
become a strategic necessity rather than a competitive advantage.
• This session presents a real-world transformation journey that demonstrates how
Odoo can serve as a catalyst for manufacturing excellence. Rather than showcasing
software features, the discussion focuses on business outcomes, implementation
strategies, and practical lessons that manufacturers, business leaders, and Odoo
partners can apply within their own organizations and customer engagements.
• Attendees will leave with a deeper understanding of how digital transformation
extends beyond ERP implementation to become an enabler of operational resilience,
continuous improvement, and sustainable business growth.

tracks.description_html: Odoo powers businesses across dozens of languages, including several spoken across India. tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Nagendra Yadav, Implementation Consultant at Odoo In
tracks.description_html:
Odoo Timesheet Assistant: Work Smarter, Track Better

What will you learn?

In this session, you’ll discover how Odoo Timesheet Assistant can make time tracking simpler, faster, and more accurate. You’ll learn how to:

  • Track time effortlessly across projects, tasks, and activities.
  • Understand where your working hours are actually being spent.
  • Identify time-consuming activities and improve productivity.
  • Monitor project progress and profitability using actual time spent.
  • Reduce manual effort and make timesheet management easier.
  • Use accurate time data to make better business and project decisions.

Why should you attend?

Time is one of the most valuable resources in any organization—but are you really spending it where it matters?

Whether you are a project manager, consultant, team member, business owner, or student, this session will show you how to use Odoo Timesheet Assistant to capture your time accurately, understand your productivity, manage projects more effectively, and turn time data into actionable insights.

Join the session to learn how better time tracking can lead to better productivity, better project management, and better business performance.

tracks.name: AI-Driven RFM Analysis: Turning Customer Segments into Revenue Growth with AI-Driven RFM
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Payal Kheradiya, Customer Success Manager at SETU CONSULTING SERVICES PRIVATE LIMITED
tracks.description_html:
𝐘𝐨𝐮'𝐯𝐞 𝐬𝐞𝐠𝐦𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐲𝐨𝐮𝐫 𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬. 𝐍𝐨𝐰 𝐢𝐭'𝐬 𝐭𝐢𝐦𝐞 𝐭𝐨 𝐠𝐫𝐨𝐰 𝐭𝐡𝐞𝐦.

Every business using Odoo's RFM Analysis knows who its Champions, Loyal Customers, Promising Customers, At-Risk Customers, and Sleeping Customers are.
But segmentation is only the starting point.

The real opportunity lies in answering the questions every business leader asks:
- 𝐖𝐡𝐚𝐭 𝐚𝐜𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬 𝐰𝐢𝐥𝐥 𝐜𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐛𝐢𝐠𝐠𝐞𝐬𝐭 𝐛𝐮𝐬𝐢𝐧𝐞𝐬𝐬 𝐢𝐦𝐩𝐚𝐜𝐭?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐝𝐞𝐬𝐞𝐫𝐯𝐞 𝐢𝐦𝐦𝐞𝐝𝐢𝐚𝐭𝐞 𝐚𝐭𝐭𝐞𝐧𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐞𝐫𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐭𝐡𝐞 𝐧𝐞𝐱𝐭 𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞 𝐨𝐩𝐩𝐨𝐫𝐭𝐮𝐧𝐢𝐭𝐲?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐫𝐞𝐥𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐬𝐡𝐢𝐩𝐬 𝐬𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐥𝐝 𝐛𝐞 𝐩𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐞𝐜𝐭𝐞𝐝 𝐛𝐞𝐟𝐨𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐯𝐞𝐧𝐮𝐞 𝐢𝐬 𝐥𝐨𝐬𝐭?
- 𝐖𝐡𝐢𝐜𝐡 𝐜𝐮𝐬𝐭𝐨𝐦𝐞𝐫𝐬 𝐚𝐫𝐞 𝐫𝐞𝐚𝐝𝐲 𝐟𝐨𝐫 𝐜𝐫𝐨𝐬𝐬-𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐥 𝐨𝐫 𝐮𝐩𝐬𝐞𝐥𝐥?

This session introduces AI-Driven RFM—an intelligent evolution of RFM Analysis that transforms customer segments into actionable growth opportunities.
Instead of stopping at customer classification, AI-Driven RFM continuously analyzes customer behavior, purchasing patterns, sales history, and revenue trends to surface the opportunities that matter most. From revenue forecasting and churn prevention to personalized customer recommendations and opportunity prioritization, discover how businesses can shift from understanding customer segments to driving measurable business growth.
More importantly, this isn't a session about AI features—it's about business outcomes. Learn how organizations can empower sales, marketing, and leadership teams with intelligent recommendations that improve customer retention, increase Customer Lifetime Value, uncover untapped revenue opportunities, and help every decision contribute to sustainable growth.

𝐊𝐞𝐲 𝐋𝐞𝐚𝐫𝐧𝐢𝐧𝐠𝐬 :

- Learn how to turn customer segments into revenue-generating action plans.

tracks.name: Hands-Free Finance: End-to-End Banking Automation in Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Megha Rughani, Co-Founder at Deep Purple
tracks.description_html:
What if your finance team no longer had to spend hours uploading payment files, checking bank accounts, posting receipts, and reconciling statements?

In this session, we explore how we transformed Odoo into a highly automated banking platform built around four key pillars:

Automated Payments – Approved vendor payments are transmitted directly from Odoo to the bank, eliminating manual exports, uploads, and duplicate data entry.

Beneficiary Verification – Before money is released, Odoo validates beneficiary banking details, helping prevent payment errors and strengthening financial controls.

Live Bank Visibility – Bank balances and statements are retrieved directly into Odoo, giving finance teams a single source of truth without constantly switching between banking portals and the ERP.

Live Demo: The session includes a real-world client demonstration videos showcasing these banking workflows in action within a production environment.

Automatic Receipts & Reconciliation – Incoming funds automatically generate customer receipts, while statement lines, receipts, and payments are matched and reconciled with minimal human intervention.

Rather than focusing on APIs and technical architecture, this session focuses on the functional business outcomes: reduced administration, stronger controls, lower operational risk, faster month-end close, and a finance function that can scale without increasing headcount. Ultimately, it is a story about moving towards a self-driving finance department where people manage exceptions and Odoo handles the routine work.

Through these successful implementations, Softprime's customers have achieved greater operational efficiency, improved decision-making, stronger process control, and scalable digital foundations that support sustainable growth and innovation in the energy sector.

speakers.biography_html:
Founder & Chief Executive Officer | Softprime Consulting Pvt Ltd

Ajeet Kumar Yadav is the Founder and Chief Executive Officer of Softprime Consulting Pvt Ltd, a global digital transformation and enterprise technology consulting company specializing in ERP implementation, business automation, artificial intelligence, and industry-specific software solutions.

With more than a decade of experience in enterprise technology, ERP consulting, Python development, and large-scale business process transformation, Ajeet has built a reputation as a trusted technology leader and one of the most experienced Odoo implementation specialists serving clients across India, East Africa, the Middle East, Europe, and North America.

Under his leadership, Softprime Consulting has successfully delivered 200+ ERP and digital transformation projects across diverse industries, including Energy & Petroleum, Healthcare, Manufacturing, Retail, Logistics, Hospitality, Education, Construction, and Professional Services. The company has become recognized for delivering scalable, enterprise-grade solutions that help organizations streamline operations, improve visibility, and accelerate growth.

Ajeet's expertise extends beyond traditional ERP implementations. He is a strong advocate of integrating Artificial Intelligence (AI), Machine Learning, IoT, Cloud Infrastructure, Business Intelligence, and Automation Technologies into modern enterprise ecosystems. His strategic vision has enabled organizations to transition from fragmented legacy systems to intelligent, data-driven platforms that support real-time decision-making and sustainable business growth.

One of his most notable achievements includes leading the digital transformation journey of Horn Petroleum Group, where he spearheaded the implementation of a centralized Odoo ERP ecosystem supporting more than 100 users across multiple business entities and operational locations. The project unified finance, procurement, inventory, fuel operations, logistics, and reporting into a single platform, delivering significant improvements in operational efficiency, transparency, compliance, and executive decision-making. The implementation also introduced advanced analytics and automation capabilities, establishing a benchmark for ERP excellence within the regional energy sector.

As a technology entrepreneur, Ajeet continuously drives innovation through investments in AI-powered business solutions, cloud-native architectures, DevOps automation, and industry-focused ERP products. His commitment to quality, innovation, and customer success has positioned Softprime Consulting as a trusted digital transformation partner for organizations seeking long-term technology leadership.

Beyond business, Ajeet is passionate about fostering open-source innovation, mentoring emerging technology professionals, and contributing to the global Odoo ecosystem. He regularly shares insights on ERP strategy, enterprise automation, AI adoption, and digital transformation, helping organizations navigate the evolving landscape of modern business technology.

tracks.name: Quality Checks Made Easier
tracks.location: Convention Hall 1, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Ankit Kumar, Implementation consultant at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
Quality Checks Made Easier with Odoo 20

Ensuring product quality at every stage can become challenging when inspections are handled manually, recorded on paper, or tracked across different systems. Odoo 20 Quality makes this process more structured, automated, and traceable.

In this session, we’ll explore how Odoo 20 helps businesses manage quality checks across receipts, manufacturing, operations, and deliveries, while giving teams better visibility and control over the entire quality process.

What you’ll learn:

  • How to automate quality checks at different stages of your operations
  • How Quality Control Points can trigger inspections automatically
  • How to perform different types of checks, including Pass/Fail, Measurement, Worksheets, and Picture-based inspections
  • How to manage failed quality checks and initiate corrective actions
  • How Odoo provides end-to-end quality traceability across operations
  • How to reduce manual inspection work and improve production quality

Why attend?

If you’re looking to standardize quality inspections, reduce manual errors, and improve visibility across your operations, this session will show you how Odoo 20 can make quality management simpler, smarter, and more connected.

The session will highlight a practical CPQ workflow, key design considerations, and common mistakes to avoid during implementation. Attendees will leave with clear, actionable insights on when CPQ is the right fit and how to leverage it effectively within Odoo to enable faster, more reliable sales processes.

tracks.name: Untangling Fashion Retail: Custom POS & Simplified Manufacturing Subcontracting in Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 2B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Sumit Mittal, Founder & CEO at SA PODIT Services LLP
tracks.description_html:
Target Audience: Odoo Partners, Developers, Functional Consultants, and Textile/Apparel Business Owners.

Description
Managing high-volume festive retail alongside unpredictable apparel manufacturing is an operational nightmare. In the clothing industry, workflows are rarely linear; a single garment often moves between multiple subcontracting partners for design, embroidery, and jari work without a rigid sequence. This talk showcases a real-world case study of a wholesale and retail clothing brand that simplified its operations using custom Odoo apps integrated with Odoo POS and Manufacturing (MRP) modules.

Key Learnings for the Audience
1. Queue-Busting Execution: How introducing a mobile Salesperson App and thermal printing directly solves retail bottlenecks and prevents cart abandonment during peak festive crowds.
2. Adapting MRP to Real-World Chaos: How a simplified manufacturing approach allows businesses with non-linear workflows to manage multiple subcontractors without rigid system restrictions.

tracks.name: One Platform, Two Industries: How Odoo Transformed Operations for a Global Engineering Firm and a Large-Scale Solar Energy Company
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Swapnil Roy, Senior Business Development Manager at TIMUS CONSULTING SERVICES (OPC) PRIVATE LIMITED
tracks.description_html: What does a Germany-based engineering consultancy and a large-scale solar energy company operating across Karnataka and Maharashtra have in common? Both were running on fragmented systems that couldn't keep pace with their growth — and both found their answer in Odoo. In this session, Swapnil Roy from Timus Consulting Services takes the audience through two real-world customer success stories that demonstrate the true breadth and flexibility of Odoo as a business platform. The first story is GKW Consult GmbH, a German engineering and consulting firm that struggled with siloed financial data, manual project tracking, and reports that were outdated before they reached the boardroom. Timus implemented Odoo's Accounting and Finance and Project Management modules, and integrated them with Power BI to deliver live dashboards that gave leadership real-time visibility into project profitability, cash flow, and resource utilisation — all in one place. The second story is ECE India, a large-scale solar energy company with operations spread across two states. Managing field teams, tracking equipment issues, and resolving customer and operational complaints at scale was a growing challenge. Timus deployed Odoo's Helpdesk module to bring structure, traceability, and speed to their support and issue resolution workflows — enabling ECE India to manage operations more efficiently as they continue to scale. Together, these two stories show how Odoo serves as a single, adaptable platform across vastly different industries — from professional services to renewable energy. Attendees will walk away with practical insights on ERP implementation strategy, module selection, cross-tool integration, and how to build Odoo solutions that actually get used by the teams they're built for. This session is ideal for Odoo partners, business owners, operations leaders, and anyone evaluating how Odoo can solve real business problems at scale.

tracks.description_html:
Odoo's command-line interface isn't just for running the server anymore.

Over the years, it has grown into a powerful toolkit that can help you manage databases, modules, generate realistic demo data, and even interact directly with the ORM through Odoo Shell.

tracks.name: Turn Interest into Meetings with Appointments & Calendar
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1A, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Sohil Vanzara, Business Support Analyst at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:

Discover how Odoo Appointments and Calendar can transform scheduling from a back-and-forth administrative task into a seamless part of your customer journey.

See how customers can find the right time, get the information they need, and book an appointment — even when your team isn't available to answer the phone. Behind the scenes, automated confirmations, reminders, calendar updates, and other workflows reduce administrative work — allowing your team to spend less time managing appointments and more time focusing on customers, consultations, and the work that matters.

Who should attend?
Business owners, sales teams, consultants, service providers, and anyone managing customer appointments or team availability.

Why attend?
Because the journey from “I'm interested” to “It's booked” shouldn't be complicated.

tracks.name: XMLRPC is dead. All Hail JSON-2
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 4, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Jay Chauhan, Odoo Developer at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html: This talk explores Odoo’s transition from XML-RPC to JSON-2 and what this change means for developers building integrations with Odoo. We’ll look at how XML-RPC has traditionally been used, where it falls short, and how JSON-2 approaches the same problem differently. Through practical examples, the session will cover authentication, API calls, request and response handling, and common integration patterns, followed by a look at what it takes to migrate existing XML-RPC integrations to JSON-2 and what developers should consider when building new integrations.

tracks.name: Manufacturing Automation with IoT in Odoo
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 1B, Ground Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Brijesh Vadodariya, CTO & Co-Founder at MICRA DIGITAL LLP
tracks.description_html:
Our project shows how we are replacing manual work in manufacturing with smart, automated systems using IoT devices connected to Odoo.

1. Automated Product Counting
Earlier, counting products on the production line was done manually, which took time and was prone to errors. We built an automated counting system that counts products in real-time and also detects rejected/defective pieces automatically. The system shows exactly how many pieces were rejected and how many more need to be produced or added to complete the order, removing the need for manual tracking and calculation.

2. Smart Weighing Scale for Packaging
We developed an IoT-based weighing scale that helps during the packaging process. Instead of manually counting pieces before packing, the scale calculates the number of pieces directly from the weight of the bag. It checks the weight against a set target and tolerance, confirms if it's correct, and automatically registers the bag count - making packaging faster and more accurate.

3. Custom Odoo Manufacturing Modules
We have also built our own advanced manufacturing modules in Odoo and integrated our IoT devices directly with it. This means all the data from counting and weighing flows straight into Odoo - connected to invoices, packing lists, and lot tracking. These modules are already helping multiple industries manage their manufacturing and packaging operations more efficiently.

In short: Our system connects physical devices (counting sensors, weighing scales) with Odoo software, so manufacturing data is captured automatically, accurately, and in real-time - reducing manual work and human error on the shop floor.

tracks.name: Automate Deferred Revenue & Expense Recognition
tracks.location: Seminar Hall 3B, First Floor, Mahatma Mandir
tracks.speaker_line: Sanjana Modi, Business Support Analyst at Odoo IN
tracks.description_html:
In many businesses, payments and expenses don’t align neatly with the periods in which revenue is earned or expenses are incurred. This can lead to distorted financial reports, inaccurate performance insights, and hours of manual work.

In this session, we’ll explore the real-world challenges behind deferred revenue and deferred expenses, why proper timing matters, and how businesses can automate the recognition process in Odoo.

Through practical business cases and a live demonstration, you’ll see how Odoo can turn a traditionally manual accounting process into a structured and automated workflow — helping finance teams maintain cleaner financial statements and make better decisions.

Whether you work in finance, run a business, or simply want to understand how accounting automation works, this session will help you make deferred revenue and expenses simpler, smarter, and easier to manage.
